description: Make a printable word search from a list of words, with an answer key. Good for themes, holidays, vocabulary and spelling lists, from preschool (10 × 10, easy, picture list) to adults and large print. Up to 40 puzzles in one PDF (a different grid each, one per student). Children can also play it on a screen.

answer_key.description: Add answer keys at the end (on by default).

decoration.description: A themed border with matching pictures, drawn around the sheet: "line" for a plain border, "none" for nothing, or a theme such as halloween, christmas, thanksgiving, spring, dinosaurs, space, ocean, animals, birthday, back-to-school (95 themes; find_printables shows a theme’s name). Leave out for no border.

difficulty.description: easy: across and down only; medium: also diagonal; hard: also backwards.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

grid_size.description: Grid size in letters per side: 10 (young children), 12, 15 (the usual), 18 or 20 (hard). A word longer than the grid is left out.

large.description: Bigger, bolder letters for young children and beginning readers (for older eyes, use large_print).

large_print.description: Large print for older eyes or low vision: bigger, bolder letters and roomier layouts (sizes are capped to fit). For young children, use large.

letter_case.description: Letters in the grid: upper (the default) or lower.

names.description: Optional names, one puzzle each (first names are enough). Shown and printed in the chat only: like the site, the link never carries names, so a person opening the link types them on the page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

picture_list.description: Show the words to find as pictures, for children who cannot read yet: "words" (picture and word), "only" (pictures alone) or "off". Words without a picture are left out.

puzzles.description: How many different puzzles of the same words in the PDF, e.g. one per student.

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "Fall Word Search". Keep it short.

words.description: The words to hide, one per entry (2 to 40). Use plain, familiar words suited to the reader, e.g. "pumpkin", "acorn", "scarecrow".

name: make_word_search

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Word search
